description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


## 中文

- 完整版新增文档提取。可从截图中识别文字、表格和公式，并导出为 Word、PDF 或 Markdown。
- 拼图完成后可直接在图像编辑器中打开结果。使用序号工具时，按住 Shift 拖动可添加与序号绑定的箭头。
- 可在全屏时自动停用选定的全局鼠标操作和快捷键，也可在「关于」页面手动检查更新。
- 表格、公式和图片转换现在会显示模型处理进度。截图翻译显示更流畅，并修复了自动复制识别文字并结束截图时偶尔未能复制的问题。

## English

- Snow Shot can extract text, tables, and equations from screenshots and export them as Word, PDF, or Markdown.
- Open a finished collage directly in the image editor. With the numbered marker tool, Shift-drag to add an arrow attached to the marker.
- Choose which global mouse actions and shortcuts pause in fullscreen. You can also check for updates from the About page.
- Table, equation, and image conversion now show when the model is working. Screenshot translations appear more smoothly, and automatic copy-and-close reliably copies recognized text.

## 下载指南 / Download guide

完整版包含全部功能。Mini 体积更小，保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏和手动文字识别。也可在 [Gitee 发布页](https://gitee.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/tag/v1.5.8_snow-shot) 下载同名文件。

Snow Shot includes all features. Mini is smaller and includes screenshots, annotations, pinned images, collages, recording, and manual text recognition.
